name: csgs-remote
description: Remote CSGS integration for MCP-first Codex session summaries with automatic sync.

interface.shortDescription: Record Codex sessions to a remote CSGS server.
interface.longDescription: CSGS Remote records Codex coding sessions on demand through MCP-first tools with a CLI fallback. The endpoint is configured by csgs install --mode remote --endpoint.
defaultPrompt: Use CSGS Remote to summarize and record this session
